messages:
morgan: CI is red on the e2e suite — multiple failures in tests/db/connection_timeout_test.js. Logs show 'server closed the connection unexpectedly'. Rerunning now but wanted to flag in case it's infra (job 4921).
ci-bot: Workflow failed — see https://ci.redwood.example/runs/4921. Rerun: <button>
tara: I can confirm — mock-postgres pod in the test cluster restarted 3x in the last 10m. Kube events show liveness probe failures.
henry: Which job number and cluster? I'll pull the pod logs.
morgan: job 4921 in ci-test-cluster, runner pool 'shared-ephemeral'. Thanks.
henry: Logs from mock-postgres pod (last 200 lines):
```
FATAL:  terminating connection due to administrator command
server closed the connection unexpectedly
LOG:  could not send data to client: Connection reset by peer
Container terminated with status OOMKilled
```
jamal: OOMKilled — did we change memory limits for the mock image recently? evie, any infra deploys?
evie: I pushed an image with extra query logging earlier but did not touch resource limits. Rolling back image tag to previous now.
tara: @ci-bot can you queue a rerun for pipeline 4921? Need to know if rollback helps :pray:
ci-bot: Rerun queued for pipeline 4921 — build 4921.2. Tagging with `infra-investigating`.
henry: Quick bisect: isolated test runs pass locally, only fails under full parallel e2e run. Looks like flake under load (connection storms). Opened a small PR to add a retry around the flaky DB check: https://git.redwood/PR/3246 (temp mitigation).
morgan: Prefer not to skip in CI. If rerun goes green we'll keep investigating infra side.
evie: Rolled back image and bumped mock-postgres mem limit to 512Mi in the test cluster. Watching pod restarts.
tara: If it flaps again, let's consider pinning CI runners to the kernel-updated node pool — we saw conntrack drops in that pool last month. Filing follow-up in eng-infra.
morgan: Great. If rerun succeeds, mark green and open a ticket for a deeper root-cause (DNS/conntrack vs resource tuning). Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
